concept: A massive concrete wall bisecting the composition vertically, one side crumbling and fractured in sharp geometric chunks, the other side smooth and imposing. Behind the wall on both sides, silhouettes of figures frozen in conflict—some reaching, some retreating. Storm clouds gather overhead with jagged lightning bolts. The ground beneath is split, with one half flooded and turbulent, the other scorched and cracked. Color palette: deep blues and grays bleeding into orange and red at the fractures. Style: bold, expressionist, high contrast, minimal detail, emphasis on structural division and tension.
explanation: Today's headlines depict a world fractured at every level—political divisions within governments (Vance breaking with Trump, Democrats versus executive veto), geopolitical fractures (Ukraine, Israel, Iran, Hong Kong), and nature itself destabilized by climate crisis (typhoons, bear attacks). The wall metaphor captures both literal walls of oppression and the abstract barriers preventing cooperation or resolution. The dual landscape reflects the simultaneous crises: conflict and environmental collapse pressing in from opposite directions.

headlines.title: Vance walks Trump tightrope with scathing election critique blaming Iran war
headlines.summary: The vice-president's blunt assessment of Republican election defeat marked one of the sharpest breaks with a sitting president in recent memory.

headlines.title: What Democrats can and can't do with their new power after taking Congress
headlines.summary: Democrats can vote legislation through. But Trump still has veto power.

headlines.title: Joshua Wong, face of Hong Kong's pro-democracy protests, jailed for 10 years
headlines.summary: Wong, 30, is among hundreds of Hongkongers detained under the controversial national security law.

headlines.title: French blood storage impacted by freezer hacks as theories swirl about culprits
headlines.summary: The French Blood Establishment (EFS) said cold rooms storing blood were impacted by hackers.

headlines.title: Typhoons batter East Asia as El Niño makes Pacific 'burn with fever'
headlines.summary: Even for countries where typhoons are a way of life, the last few months have brought unusually wild weather.

headlines.title: 'Most difficult days of my life' for keeper Owono
headlines.summary: FC Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono puts out a statement through his club, expressing his sorrow and pain after Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel's death.

headlines.title: Pope Leo hosts Bob Dylan at official residence in Rome
headlines.summary: Pope Leo had previously quoted Dylan's work in the preface of a book warning against nuclear rearmament.

headlines.title: Mother and daughter die after suspected grizzly bear attack in Canada
headlines.summary: Authorities in British Columbia say evidence suggests an animal may have been involved in the women's deaths.

headlines.title: Ukraine says bodycam video shows deadly Russian double-tap bombing
headlines.summary: At least 40 people were killed and another 30 may still be under the rubble after Monday's attack on a Ukrainian village, Kyiv says.

headlines.title: Israel's president begins consultations with parties after election deadlock
headlines.summary: Herzog warns politicians that "not every commitment and promise can be fulfilled" if they want to avoid another election.

headlines.title: Secret police files released in Hungary, 37 years after fall of communism
headlines.summary: Critics say the move comes too late, that the files themselves are incomplete, and the move risks sowing division and causing unnecessary anguish.

headlines.title: Iran's chief negotiator says Americans voted 'no to war'
